name: text_to_speech_long
description: Convert long text to speech using Soniox. Returns an MP3 audio file that arrives asynchronously, in a separate message, instead of as the tool result. Soniox silently cuts the audio at 2 minutes, which is about 1800 characters at normal speed and less at slower speeds, so keep each call to about 1800 characters and split longer text into one call per piece. Use text_to_speech for short text. Set language to the language the text is written in. Speed ranges from 0.7 to 1.3, where 1.0 is normal; keep speed changes small. Silence reduction only works on models that support it. Async tools cannot be batched.

text.description: The text to convert to speech, up to about 1800 characters. Split longer text into one piece per call.

voice.description: Soniox voice name or ID. Omit to use the configured default.

language.description: ISO language code of the text, for example en or el. Omit to use the configured default.

speed.description: Speech speed from 0.7 to 1.3, where 1.0 is normal. Keep changes small, because large jumps are very noticeable. Omit to use the configured default.

reduce_silence.description: Shorten pauses between words. Only works on models that support it. Omit to use the configured default.
